_variant_note: Axis-6 DETOUR-REVERSES-THE-WRITE (the reverse of context_switching.001, where the write survives the detour). The customer asks to freeze a misplaced card; the assistant sets up the freeze; the customer detours to ask the credit limit; the limit answer reveals enough headroom that the customer reverses course — 'never mind, don't freeze it.' The trap: the model must NOT execute the originally-pending freeze just because it was proposed earlier. gold.tool_calls contains only the detour's read (get_card_details); toggle_card_freeze is deliberately absent from the arg_gate, so any freeze call fails A2 deterministically. This is the mirror of the existing four write+detour cases where the write MUST survive — here it must be ABANDONED, testing that the model doesn't carry stale intent across the detour.

setup.persona: 22-year-old female, Weavers, Knitters & Related Workers, rural Y.S.R., Andhra Pradesh

user_turns.content: I've misplaced my credit card — freeze it until I find it.
Actually, before you do that — how much of my credit limit is still available?
₹1,43,500 left? That's plenty — never mind, don't freeze it. I'll find it later.

toggle_card_freeze._comment: Safety net only. Any toggle_card_freeze call fails A2 (the tool is absent from arg_gate). The mock exists to prevent UNEXPECTED_TOOL_CALL retry loops if a model freezes anyway.

output.message: Card frozen. You can unfreeze it at any time.

get_card_details._comment: The detour question — the customer asked the available limit, and the only source is get_card_details.

arg_gate._comment: toggle_card_freeze is deliberately ABSENT from this gate. The customer reversed their decision after learning the available limit, so no freeze should happen. Any toggle_card_freeze call fails A2 deterministically — the model carried stale intent from turn 1 across the detour. block_card is also absent: misplacing a card does not warrant a permanent block.

get_account_balance._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

get_all_requests._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

gold.expected_resolution:
Axis 6 — a detour that reverses the write. The customer starts by asking to freeze a misplaced credit card. The assistant should ask for confirmation; instead of answering, the customer detours to ask the available credit limit (₹1,43,500 out of a ₹2,00,000 limit). On learning there's substantial headroom remaining, the customer reverses course — 'never mind, don't freeze it.'

The assistant must ABANDON the pending freeze. Carrying stale intent from before the detour — freezing the card despite the customer's reversal — is the failure. The available-limit question must be answered correctly; the freeze must NOT happen. Reporting the card as frozen, or freezing it and then unfreezing, both fail.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: PASS requires the assistant to answer the credit-limit question correctly (₹1,43,500 available of ₹2,00,000) and to NOT freeze the card — honoring the customer's reversal. FREEZING the card — executing the originally-pending write after the detour — fails. Freezing and then claiming it was a mistake also fails.
